Issue: Whse (branch) typed inconsistently: lower case, trailing/leading spaces, full names (e.g. 'riv', 'Riverton ', ' OAK')
Detection: value_counts() on Whse: 14 distinct spellings for 4 branches
Rule_Applied: TRIM + UPPER + alias map to RIV/OAK/PIN/ELM; assert no unmapped values

Issue: Acct stored as float text ('6100.0') or with leading space (' 6100')
Detection: value_counts() on Acct: 21 distinct values for 7 accounts
Rule_Applied: TRIM, strip '.0', assert 4-digit code. Without it these R&M lines would silently drop out

Issue: TransDate in two formats: ISO YYYY-MM-DD and US MM/DD/YYYY
Detection: Regex pattern profile of TransDate; 355 slash dates have 2nd part >12 (so MM/DD); DD/MM would place 49 lines after their own export
Rule_Applied: Parse slash dates as MM/DD/YYYY; assert TransDate <= ExportedAt for every line

Issue: Duplicate lines: export of 2026-09-21 06:00 (a Monday re-run) repeats all 719 lines of the 2026-09-19 export (TransDate 12-18 Sep)
Detection: duplicated() on SRO+Line: 1,438 rows; identical content after normalising formats; ExportedAt per date window shows two exports covering 12-18 Sep
Rule_Applied: Keep first occurrence per SRO+Line (2026-09-19 export); drop 719 copies

Issue: Lines dated outside Q3 (20-30 Jun from the 27-Jun export; 1-3 Oct from the 03-Oct and 10-Oct exports)
Rule_Applied: Rule 3: keep 1-Jul to 30-Sep by TransDate only

Issue: Lines on non-R&M group accounts (5100 billable labor, 6300 fluids, 6400 fuel, 6500 shop supplies)
R&M-account lines carrying a customer number (C1044/C2087/C3310) - could be mistaken for billable work
Rule_Applied: Rule 1: account decides, line kept in R&M (no change)

Issue: R&M-account lines on SRO operations 75/100 (capitalized rebuilds)
Detection: Filter Oper in (75,100) & Acct in R&M
Rule_Applied: Rule 2: exclude every line on Oper 75/100

Issue: Reversal lines (negative Qty / ExtCost) on R&M accounts
Detection: Qty < 0; checked Qty*UnitCost = ExtCost on all lines (0 mismatches)
Rule_Applied: Rule 3: keep, counted in month of own TransDate (no change)
Rule 4: re-assign to OAK (total unchanged; ELM/OAK split moves)

Issue: Embedded SUBTOTAL rows per account-month (JournalID='SUBTOTAL', Source blank) - would double count
Detection: JournalID value scan, Description 'Subtotal ...'; each subtotal re-computed from detail and ties exactly
Rule_Applied: Drop SUBTOTAL rows; use detail only

Detection: pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') returns NaN for 18 rows; openpyxl cell types show str

Issue: PostingDate stored as text in DD/MM/YYYY
Detection: Pattern profile; day part up to 31
